en: Dependent on a visible and impinging material phenomenon, there arises a non-visible and non-impinging immaterial phenomenon by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition, three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition, three.
Dependent on a non-visible and non-impinging immaterial phenomenon, there arises a non-non-visible-and-non-impinging and non-immaterial phenomenon by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-visible and non-impinging immaterial phenomenon, there arises a non-non-visible-and-impinging [phenomenon]...

A non-visible, non-reacting, immaterial dhamma arises by way of root condition …pe… dependent on a non-visible, non-reacting, immaterial dhamma, there arise non-visible-with-obstruction, non-immaterial, and non-non-visible-non-non-reacting dhammas by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six …pe… under mutuality condition there are three …pe… under non-disappearance condition there are six.
